qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Proprietary flavour and fragrance formulation IP, captive aroma molecule palettes, and deep customer co-development create high switching barriers and pricing power in core fragrance and taste ingredients, though legacy animal nutrition assets severely depressed combined financial returns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). While Firmenich brings world-class flavour and fragrance formulation IP, the combined entity remains constrained by the specialty chemicals cycle and legacy DSM vitamin exposure. The complex €18B merger, multi-billion write-downs, discounted ANH carve-out, and fragrance antitrust class-action settlements introduce severe structural uncertainty, capping CAP at 5 years (ROIC 2.4%).
qualitative.evidence: TTM GAAP ROIC is 2.4% (median 2.4%), with TTM net income of -€1,107m. Balance sheet carries over €15B in goodwill and intangibles post-merger. Animal Nutrition separation and global antitrust investigations illustrate deep restructuring headwinds that impair long-term compounding predictability.
